done_when: all four checks refuse a seeded bad card and pass a good one
goal: Cards fail fast, at zero token cost, on the cheap classes of fundamental error.

latest.line: Opus gate: operator's latest message or an approved crucial OPUS card; Haiku rule for scop

steps: formula id on a card must exist in FORMULAS.md
trial-ledger count must equal runs in runs.jsonl for a run card
a card cited in another card's scope_in is raised to B-shared automatically
mutation check: a card's test suite must fail on dummy or shuffled output
title: Lab: machine checks for formula id, trial ledger vs runs, auto B-shared on citation, mutation check of tests
